clock_overhead: four clock_gettime reads per wrapped call: wall-start, CPU-start, CPU-end, wall-end; no subtraction; clock-helper conversion and call-return costs inside each interval included; sample storage after final reads outside
equivalence: same-target repeated reference/measured raw output.s16le and beam.f32le plus every canonical frame/public metric exactly equal; input source hashes and full original B3 validation retained
frame_combined_cost: sum of disjoint producer-capture, producer-render, worker intervals; excludes fixture copies, post-clock sample storage, frame validation and output I/O
quantile: nearest rank ceil(p*N), all 600 frames per process
repeats_summary: retain all three separate runs, no fastest-run selection or averaging percentiles
rss_scope: Linux parent wait4 ru_maxrss for the exact target PID through exit, KiB*1024; includes harness/libc/loader; QEMU includes emulator host process
source_policy: original B3 and DSP untouched; source equality checked before compile and readonly verification; execution input identity captured separately
timed_bind: fe_b3_f0_bind only; not complete construction or process cold start
timing_acceptance: descriptive, no hosted or QEMU numerical speed gate
